{{Infobox auto|title=Elegy of Icarus|type=[[Blessing]]}}
The '''Elegy of Icarus''' is a [[blessing]], a crafted enchanted book that stores [[Feather Falling]] II. It is crafted from four wind charges, three feathers and a [[Wax]].

== Obtaining ==
=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
The book in the center must be a [[Hell-Bound Book]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/blessing/feather_falling.json}}</ref> The crafted item is named "Blessing", with "Elegy of Icarus" as a dark gray lore line.

== Usage ==
The Elegy of Icarus is applied to equipment in an [[anvil]], like an {{MCW|Enchanted Book|enchanted book}}. Feather Falling applies to boots. The pack doubles its effect, so Feather Falling II reduces fall damage by 48%.

== Trivia ==
* Icarus flew on wings of feathers and wax made by his father Daedalus (see [[Prayer of Daedalus]]) and fell when the sun melted the wax, which the recipe's feathers and wax refer to. The pack has an advancement called "Icarus' Folly".
